name: Peach Glazed Chicken Breast
desc: Roasted chicken breast with a sweet peach glaze
cookNotes: Glaze in the last 5 minutes so it sets, not burns. Whole breast, spoon the peaches over. Mashed potatoes and green beans alongside.
variations: Mechanical altered: dice the breast to 1/2 inch and serve the glaze on the side. No added sugar: swap the glaze for a peach and thyme pan sauce.
garnish: Thyme sprig and a spoon of sliced peaches
method: Heat the oven to 375°F. Pat the chicken dry and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Sear in oil, skin side down, 3 to 4 minutes until golden. Move to sheet pans.
While it roasts, simmer the peaches, preserves, vinegar and thyme 8 minutes until glossy. Whisk in the butter off the heat.
Glaze the chicken in the last 5 minutes so it sets, not burns.
Rest 4 minutes before plating. Hold hot at 140°F or above.
plating: Mashed potatoes at 10 o'clock, green beans at 2 o'clock.
Breast at 6 o'clock, sliced on the bias if the resident prefers.
Spoon 2 oz warm glaze over the breast, then the peaches.
Thyme sprig on top. Wipe the rim.
